name: Indian Kachumber Protein Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup sprouted moong beans, steamed for 5 minutes
1 cucumber, 1 tomato and ½ onion, diced
½ tsp chaat masala and ½ tsp roasted cumin powder
steps: Steam the sprouts for 5 minutes so they are safe to eat and easier to digest; cool.
Toss the sprouts, chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, onion and coriander in a bowl.
Add the paneer or tofu cubes.
Dress with lemon juice, chaat masala, cumin, chilli and black salt.
note: A high-protein chaat-style salad with no frying and no added oil.
